from daedalus.structcore.artifacts import extract_literals, resolve_literals

literals_by_file = {}
for rel, text in file_texts.items():
    literals = extract_literals(rel, text)
    if literals:
        literals_by_file[rel] = literals

report = resolve_literals(literals_by_file, known_files=set(file_texts.keys()))
